t: Architecting for AI: A Blueprint for a Nested Git Workflow
s: This article details an architectural strategy using nested Git repositories to create isolated, AI-assisted development sandboxes within a stable parent project, enabling rapid iteration without compromising code integrity or future releases.
sub: Nested Git repositories for isolated development environments
Minimizing technical debt and friction in full-stack development
Leveraging AI as a 'super-mentor' for complex systems
